meta.title: Velora — Pleated Blinds & Insect Screens
meta.description: Insect screen and pleated blind systems manufactured in Turkey. Information for trade dealers across Europe.

home.hero_eyebrow: Made in Turkey, delivered across Europe
home.hero_title: One folding system, one uninterrupted flow of air.
home.hero_subtitle: We manufacture insect screen and pleated blind systems to measure and supply trade dealers across Europe.
home.intro_text: This site is not a sales platform. It's here to introduce our products, our manufacturing process and our company to trade dealers across Europe. Orders and pricing are handled directly through personal contact.

highlights.title: Made to measure
highlights.text: Cutting, assembly and final inspection follow a controlled production flow; every unit is made to the ordered dimensions.

highlights.title: Delivery across Europe
highlights.text: We ship regularly and traceably to our dealers, with options for consolidated pallet shipments.

highlights.title: Technical support for dealers
highlights.text: We provide our dealers with technical documentation and direct support on measuring, installation and product selection.

home.products_teaser_text: From insect screen systems to pleated blinds — a wide range for every mounting type, with a broad choice of fabrics and frame colours.
home.cta_text: Contact us for product information, sample requests or dealer terms.
home.services_text: Velora does more than manufacture: our own team handles every stage, from preparing the order to measure through to packing and dispatch.

services.title: Made-to-Measure Production
services.text: Every order is produced individually to the measurements supplied by the dealer. We do not sell ready-made standard sizes from stock.

services.title: Private-Label Manufacturing
services.text: Products can be manufactured under the dealer's own brand name. Suitable for dealers who wish to sell under their own label.

services.title: Quality Control
services.text: Before dispatch, every product is checked individually for the operation of its mechanism and the quality of its finish.

services.title: Packing and Packaging
services.text: Products are packed to withstand transport without damage and prepared for dispatch.

services.title: Assembled and Knock-Down Shipping
services.text: Products can be shipped fully assembled or knocked down; knock-down shipping reduces transport volume.

home.delivery_text: Whether within Türkiye or anywhere in Europe, orders are delivered to the dealer's door within 10 days at the latest.

products.title: Products
products.intro: All our products are made to order and to measure. The details below cover general product features; contact us for technical drawings and sample requests.

items.name: Pleated Insect Screen
items.description: Accordion-folded insect screen for doors and windows, moving horizontally or vertically and retracting into its cassette when not in use.
specs: Suited to hinged and sliding doors

items.name: Sliding Insect Screen
items.description: Insect screen that slides horizontally along a track, suited to wide door and balcony openings.
specs: Available as single or double panel

items.name: Hinged Insect Screen
items.description: Classic single-panel insect screen that opens and closes like a door.
specs: Fits standard window and door sizes

items.name: Magnetic Insect Screen
items.description: Insect screen fitted with a magnetic closure strip, easy to attach and remove.
specs: Suited to rentals and simple installation

items.name: Roller Insect Screen
items.description: Insect screen that retracts into a small cassette when not in use, moving horizontally or vertically.
specs: Suited to window and door applications

items.name: Single Pleated Blind
items.description: Single-layer pleated fabric blind for windows, moving up or down.
specs: Wide range of fabrics and colours

items.name: Duo (Day & Night) Pleated Blind
items.description: Two-layer pleated blind combining a sheer and a blackout fabric for flexible light control.

items.name: Pleated Blind for Folding Glass Walls
items.description: Pleated blind solution fitted to folding glass wall systems using dedicated mounting hardware.
specs: Dedicated hardware for folding glass wall profiles

vidali.name: Screw-Fixed Pleated Blind
vidali.summary: Fixed with screws — the most robust mounting type.
vidali.description: A pleated blind made from a single layer of accordion-folded fabric. It is screwed to the window sash or the wall, giving a permanent and highly stable fitting. The blind moves up and down and stays at any height you set.
specs: Wide choice of fabrics and colours

yapistirmali.name: Adhesive Pleated Blind
yapistirmali.summary: Mounted with adhesive tape, no drilling.
yapistirmali.description: A pleated blind made from a single layer of accordion-folded fabric. It is fitted to the window sash with adhesive tape and needs no screws or drilling. Suitable for tenants and for anyone who does not want to drill into PVC frames.
specs: Wide choice of fabrics and colours

askili.name: Clip-On / EasyFix Pleated Blind
askili.summary: Fitted with clips onto the sash — no tools needed.
askili.description: A pleated blind made from a single layer of accordion-folded fabric. It is fitted with clips that slide over the edge of the window sash, needing no screws, holes or tools. It can be removed again at any time without leaving a mark.
specs: Wide choice of fabrics and colours

gece-gunduz.name: Duo (Day & Night) Pleated Blind
gece-gunduz.summary: Sheer and opaque fabric in one blind.
gece-gunduz.description: A double-layer pleated blind combining a sheer and an opaque fabric. Because the two layers move independently, you can control daylight during the day and privacy in the evening separately. It can be mounted with screws or with adhesive tape.

workshop.title: Workshop & Manufacturing
workshop.intro: Our products are made to the ordered dimensions. From cutting to assembly, every stage follows the flow below, and every product is checked before dispatch.

steps.title: Profile cutting
steps.text: Aluminium profiles are cut precisely to order dimensions at our cutting stations.

steps.title: Joining & assembly
steps.text: Cut pieces are corner-joined and assembled into a complete frame.

steps.title: Fitting the fabric or mesh
steps.text: Pleated fabric or insect mesh is tensioned into the cassette using dedicated machinery.

steps.title: Quality control
steps.text: Every product is checked before shipping for smooth mechanism operation and surface quality.

steps.title: Packing & shipping
steps.text: Products are packed to withstand transport and prepared for shipment.

about.title: We design, manufacture and deliver for projects across Europe.
intro_paragraphs: We are a manufacturing brand developing made-to-measure insect screens, pleated blinds and shading systems, managing R&D, engineering, production, quality control and logistics under one roof.

We approach every project according to its own requirements: through made-to-measure production, private-label manufacturing, rigorous quality control and professional packing, we prepare our products for dispatch either fully assembled or knocked down.
From homes to hotels and commercial spaces, from door and window systems to glass balconies and project applications, we provide solutions tailored to the measurements, the design and the project.

For our partners in Europe we combine a flexible ordering structure, reliable shipping and logistics, door-to-door delivery and a sustainable approach to materials — providing not just products, but an uninterrupted supply experience.
We turn our production capacity, our engineering approach and our European standard of service into long-term business partnerships.

values.title: Controlled production
values.text: Every product goes through a controlled process, from measurement to dispatch.

values.title: Dealer relationships
values.text: We build long-term, trust-based business relationships with our dealers.

values.title: Material quality
values.text: We prioritise durability in the aluminium profiles and fabrics we choose.
